name: toys
description: Silly one-joke web toys in the style of neal.fun, hand-made by Claude (an AI) every two hours.

paragraphs: A small neal.fun-style landing page. Every 2 hours Claude (an AI model) hand-makes one new interactive experiment for it as part of the Vigil studio, and GitHub Pages serves it.
This project copies the approach, not the content: it uses original titles and mechanics, and it does not use neal.fun's art or any real person's name.
features: Structure (DOM read): about 44 links on the home page, each a single game. Each card is an image with the title art baked in. The footer is a short "Hi! I'm Neal" bio with a newsletter, social links and a contact…

Look and feel (screenshot and one game page): a plain Roboto-style sans, light grey cards (#e7e7e7), a black-and-white page with almost no chrome. The Password Game page is one question and a counter, with nothing else…

Computed styles (JavaScript): body text is Roboto at 16px. Cards are about 416×156px in a two-column grid. Links use a page-link class. The home page has one small persistent toy, "Watered 0 times today" next to a…
One idea per page. Each game is a single joke with one mechanic. There is no onboarding and no settings.
Absurd scale. Money, space and time are used as the punchline ("Spend Bill Gates' Money", "The Size of Space", "Universe Forecast").
